ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: Both come from the land. Dry, well-roofed bedrooms and a cloth over the face in the fields keep the spores out; working upwind of the seeps, and not in the worst of the heat, keeps the fumes off. Both pass within a few days.
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.act: Keep spores and fumes off them
